Cc: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Seller Console visibility + CTA copy — quick review (AWS listing prep)

Hi team,

We have a hard cutover to submit the offer to Seller Central next week and AWS asked for final copy for the product page and CTA treatments. Attaching a lightweight mock and the current copy draft. Can you take a focused pass on the following before EOD Friday?

- Headline clarity: does the one-liner make the value prop for marketplace buyers obvious?
- CTA wording: "Get started" vs "Contact sales" vs "Request demo" (we should pick one primary CTA and a soft secondary).
- Usage/entitlement snippet: short example for AMI/SKU usage tiers (one-liner only).
- Co-sell badging: ensure we meet the co-sell badge requirements listed in the guidelines (I flagged the checklist where we're borderline).

Quick notes: target buyer is platform/infra engineering and procurement at mid-market/enterprise. Pricing will be via usage metering (hourly) and we want the CTA to favor self-serve activation if possible.

Attachments: [Attachment: offer-page-mock.png (image/png)] [Attachment: offer-copy-v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Thanks — Diego

--
Diego Fernandez
Partner Programs Lead | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Seller Console visibility + CTA copy — quick review (AWS listing prep)

Thanks Diego — good concise brief. I made inline edits and a redlined doc attached. High level suggestions:

- Headline: change to "Low-latency LLM inference for production apps" (shorter, benefits-first).
- Subhead: add a one-liner about predictable pricing and dedicated capacity options (helps procurement).
- Primary CTA: recommend "Start free trial" if we can enable a short trial SKU; otherwise "Request demo" is better than generic "Contact sales" for conversion.
- Usage snippet: replaced the long paragraph with a single example line under "How billing works" — e.g., "Estimated: 0.12 USD/100 tokens (quantized instances) — contact for committed tier pricing."
- Co-sell: flagged a couple of claims that may trigger compliance review ("enterprise-grade SLA"). Recommend toning to "SLA options available for Dedicated plans."

Attachment: [Attachment: offer-copy-v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

If we go with "Start free trial" we need an AMI/public offer SKU by Monday so ops can wire the activation flow.

—Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Product Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Looping in quick sales perspective — main ask from our AE bench: make the price anchor and CTA explicit. A couple of granular points: 

- If we use "Start free trial" we should show the trial duration (14 days) and whether it auto-converts. Ops needs to confirm auto-convert behavior for marketplace trial SKUs.
- For co-sell optics, request the "Partner Verified" badge and note co-sell enablement in the page copy (one line).
- Add a short line in the feature bullets for "migration path to Dedicated (reserved capacity)" so customers see the upgrade route.

I endorse Kimberly's headline change. I'm attaching the co-sell badge checklist we use internally — small edits only.

Attachment: [Attachment: co-sell-badge-guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)]

FWIW forwarding the thread to Marissa for the launch comms checklist.

—Ben

Hi Diego/Team,

Thanks for the updates and attachments. We reviewed the copy and the edits look straightforward. Two operational items before we can publish:

1) Seller ID & Offer mapping: we've provisionally created Offer ID 987654321 for your private listing. Please confirm the AMI/SKU mapping in Seller Central and provide the AMI manifest by Monday noon PST. Link: https://sellercentral.aws.amazon.com/offer/987654321

2) Trial activation flow: trials require the Marketplace Trials opt-in and a DocuSign for the trial terms. I can send the DocuSign if Diego confirms trial duration (Ben suggested 14 days).

For copy: 
- Headline "Low-latency LLM inference for production apps" is fine.
- For the primary CTA we recommend "Start free trial" if you have the trial SKU; otherwise set "Request demo" and we will not surface trial UX.

Next steps: confirm AMI manifest link and trial duration; once we have both I will move this to the preflight queue.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Ops
aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
